sloka: जग्राह चार्षभं चर्म खड्गं च विपुलं शुभम् ।किङ्किणीजालसञ्छन्नं चर्मणा च परिष्कृतम् ।। ६.५४.३१ ।।।।
transliteration: jagrāha cārṣabhaṁ carma khaḍgaṁ ca vipulaṁ śubham ।kiṅkiṇījālasañchannaṁ carmaṇā ca pariṣkṛtam ।। 6.54.31 ।।।।

translations.english: Then desiring victory both monkey and Rakshasa struck one another passionately in wonderful harsh ways.
